title: Chapter 170 Cavalry Vs Archers
content:
Chapter 170 Cavalry Vs Archers

In the air, arrows rained down on the city wall.

Although the city wall was fine, the soldiers defending the city were miserable and could only hide behind the battlements, not daring to show their heads.

Only when the enemy's infantry was about to climb up the city wall through ropes, did they dare to shoot down the enemy in the face of arrows.

Fortunately, there was the buff bonus of the Fountain of Life, which restored 1% of the health every minute. The injured soldiers only needed to hide and they would be alive and kicking again after a while.

"Charge."

Ayub gave an order and activated his skills at the same time.

[Iron Cavalry Charge: Increase the movement speed of your own troops by 30%, increase defense by 10%, and last for 30 minutes. ]

With the blessing of the Legion Order, the Golden Fire Cavalry, like a mad beast, pierced into the enemy's formation with an unstoppable momentum.

Zhao Tianze, who was standing in the command of the central army, was horrified when he saw the cavalry rolling in front of him.

"Shoot the cavalry, quickly...shoot the cavalry!" He showed an expression of disbelief in his eyes.

A few days ago, his scouts did not say that the other side had cavalry!

And there was no tall city wall in this place.

Seeing this majestic city wall, he was already very surprised, and the cavalry at this time made him feel even more shocked.

He thought that he could be invincible with his 400 archers, but he did not expect to encounter a torrent of steel, and he encountered it in the plain terrain.

Looking at the cavalry rushing into the formation, Zhao Tianze was ashamed.

"It's over."

The attack power of a bow and arrow is only more than 100 points of damage on average. If thousands of arrows are fired at the same time, it can cause terrible lethality, but this is based on the situation that the opponent does not use a shield for defense and can hit the opponent at the same time.

The cavalry charge is too fast, so it is not easy to hit, and the opponent can also use a spear to deflect the arrows.

This is why cavalry can restrain archers.

The archers' defense is much worse than that of infantry, and they can't even catch up with the bandits' defense.

When the golden fire cavalry rushed out of the formation, the 400 archers were directly reduced by one-third.

"Form a formation, defend!"

Zhao Tianze shouted at the top of his lungs: "Infantry, come back to help, protect the archers."

But the battlefield changes rapidly, there is still no time.

I saw Ayub rushing over with the cavalry again.

At this time, the archers' position was like being plowed, with seriously injured soldiers lying on the ground everywhere, and more of them had lost their breath!

Seeing that the situation was over, Zhao Tianze was also a decisive person and immediately summoned the warhorse.

"Retreat!" He shouted hysterically and ran away first.

Before leaving, he looked back at Wang Shuo, his eyes full of unwillingness.

"Wang Shuo, today's revenge will be avenged tomorrow!"

Wang Shuo looked at Zhao Tianze who was running away, smiled contemptuously, and snorted coldly: "You are defeated!"

The remaining infantry and archers saw their boss running away, and immediately fled for their lives. Those who had war horses immediately mounted their horses and followed Zhao Tianze to escape, while more soldiers surrendered on the spot.

Most of them were defeated for the first time and were not mentally prepared at all.

At this time, they were already heartbroken, so how could they still have the heart to resist.

Wang Shuo was in a good mood watching this scene.

After laughing foolishly for a while, he couldn't help but think about danger in times of peace.

If his troops met an invincible opponent one day, would they also be defeated like a mountain?

High morale, the will to die rather than surrender, and the determination to fight to the end.

These invisible soft powers, like sophisticated equipment, are equally important to an army.

Defeat but not collapse!

Leading troops in battle, I still have a lot to learn!
